```{r}
    hesitations_receiver = number_of_hesitations_r,
    shots_server     = number_total_of_shots_s,
    shots_receiver   = number_total_of_shots_r,
    shots_total      = number_total_shots,
    serving_team_win = did_the_serving_team_win

data <- data |>

    error_type = tolower(error_type),
    error_type = case_when(
      str_detect(error_type, "pot")        ~ "positional",
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

numeric_summary <- data |>
  summarise(
    n_rallies = n(),
    shots_total_min      = min(shots_total, na.rm = TRUE),
    shots_total_max      = max(shots_total, na.rm = TRUE),
    shots_total_mean     = mean(shots_total, na.rm = TRUE),
    shots_total_sd       = sd(shots_total, na.rm = TRUE),

    shots_server_min     = min(shots_server, na.rm = TRUE),
    shots_server_max     = max(shots_server, na.rm = TRUE),
    shots_server_mean    = mean(shots_server, na.rm = TRUE),
    shots_server_sd      = sd(shots_server, na.rm = TRUE),

    shots_receiver_min   = min(shots_receiver, na.rm = TRUE),
    shots_receiver_max   = max(shots_receiver, na.rm = TRUE),
    shots_receiver_mean  = mean(shots_receiver, na.rm = TRUE),
    shots_receiver_sd    = sd(shots_receiver, na.rm = TRUE),

    hes_server_min       = min(hesitations_server, na.rm = TRUE),
    hes_server_max       = max(hesitations_server, na.rm = TRUE),
    hes_server_mean      = mean(hesitations_server, na.rm = TRUE),
    hes_server_sd        = sd(hesitations_server, na.rm = TRUE),

    hes_receiver_min     = min(hesitations_receiver, na.rm = TRUE),
    hes_receiver_max     = max(hesitations_receiver, na.rm = TRUE),
    hes_receiver_mean    = mean(hesitations_receiver, na.rm = TRUE),
    hes_receiver_sd      = sd(hesitations_receiver, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r}
numeric_table <- tibble(
  Variable = c(
    "Total shots in rally",
    "Shots by server",
    "Shots by receiver",
    "Hesitations by server",
    "Hesitations by receiver"
  ),
  Min  = c(
    numeric_summary$shots_total_min,
    numeric_summary$shots_server_min,
    numeric_summary$shots_receiver_min,
    numeric_summary$hes_server_min,
    numeric_summary$hes_receiver_min
  ),
  Max  = c(
    numeric_summary$shots_total_max,
    numeric_summary$shots_server_max,
    numeric_summary$shots_receiver_max,
    numeric_summary$hes_server_max,
    numeric_summary$hes_receiver_max
  ),
  Mean = c(
    numeric_summary$shots_total_mean,
    numeric_summary$shots_server_mean,
    numeric_summary$shots_receiver_mean,
    numeric_summary$hes_server_mean,
    numeric_summary$hes_receiver_mean
  ),
  SD   = c(
    numeric_summary$shots_total_sd,
    numeric_summary$shots_server_sd,
    numeric_summary$shots_receiver_sd,
    numeric_summary$hes_server_sd,
    numeric_summary$hes_receiver_sd
  )
) |>
  mutate(
    across(c(Min, Max), round, 0),
    across(c(Mean, SD), ~ round(., 2))
  )

numeric_table <- numeric_table |>
  add_row(
    Variable = "Hesitation Rate Per Shot",
    Min  = round(min(data$hesitation_rate, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    Max  = round(max(data$hesitation_rate, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    Mean = round(mean(data$hesitation_rate, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    SD   = round(sd(data$hesitation_rate, na.rm = TRUE), 3)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)

# Make consistent factors / labels
data2 <- data |>
  mutate(
    hesitation_server   = factor(tolower(hesitation_server), levels = c("no", "yes")),
    hesitation_receiver = factor(tolower(hesitation_receiver), levels = c("no", "yes")),
    serving_team_win    = factor(serving_team_win, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("Loss", "Win")),
    error_type          = tolower(error_type)
  )

data2 <- data2 |>
  mutate(
    error_type = case_when(
      str_detect(error_type, "pos") ~ "positional",
      str_detect(error_type, "dec") ~ "decision",
      str_detect(error_type, "exec") ~ "execution",
      TRUE ~ error_type
    ),
    error_type = factor(error_type)
  )

categorical_table <- bind_rows(
  data2 |>
    count(hesitation_server, name = "Count") |>
    mutate(
      Variable = "Hesitation (server)",
      Value = as.character(hesitation_server)
    ) |>
    select(Variable, Value, Count),

  data2 |>
    count(hesitation_receiver, name = "Count") |>
    mutate(
      Variable = "Hesitation (receiver)",
       Value = as.character(hesitation_receiver)
    ) |>
    select(Variable,  Value, Count),

  data2 |>
    count(serving_team_win, name = "Count") |>
    mutate(
      Variable = "Serving team result",
       Value = as.character(serving_team_win)
    ) |>
    select(Variable,  Value, Count),

  data2 |>
    count(error_type, name = "Count") |>
    mutate(
      Variable = "Error type",
       Value = as.character(error_type)
    ) |>
    select(Variable,  Value, Count)
) |>
  group_by(Variable) |>
  mutate(
    Percent = round(100 * Count / sum(Count), 1)
  ) |>
  ungroup()

categorical_table
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

plot_data <- data |>
  summarise(
    server_no  = mean(serving_team_win[hesitation_server == "no"], na.rm = TRUE),
    server_yes = mean(serving_team_win[hesitation_server == "yes"], na.rm = TRUE),
    receiver_no  = mean(serving_team_win[hesitation_receiver == "no"], na.rm = TRUE),
    receiver_yes = mean(serving_team_win[hesitation_receiver == "yes"], na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = "group",
    values_to = "win_rate"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    side = case_when(
      group %in% c("server_no", "server_yes") ~ "Server",
      group %in% c("receiver_no", "receiver_yes") ~ "Receiver"
    ),
    hesitation = case_when(
      group %in% c("server_no", "receiver_no") ~ "No",
      group %in% c("server_yes", "receiver_yes") ~ "Yes"
    )
  )

library(ggplot2)
library(scales)

library(ggplot2)
library(scales)

ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = side, y = win_rate, fill = hesitation)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), width = 0.6, color = "white") +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = percent(win_rate, accuracy = 0.1)),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.7),
    vjust = -0.5,
    size = 4.5,
    fontface = "bold",
    color = "#1F1F1F"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1),
    limits = c(0, 0.8),    # top at 80% so labels don't hit the edge
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("No" ="#4885bf", "Yes" = "#FF8C1A"),
    name   = "Hesitation"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Serving Team Win Rate by Which Side Hesitated",
    x = "Team position (serving vs receiving)",
    y = "Serving team win rate"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 13, color = "#2B2B2B"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.position = "right",
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
  )
```
Interpretation - 
if receiver doesn't hesitate, serving team wins 38%
if receiver does hesitate, serving team wins 53%
if server doesn't hesitate, they win 62%
if server hesitates, they win 22%

```{r}
library(dplyr)

data <- data |>
  mutate(
    hesitation_server   = tolower(hesitation_server),
    hesitation_receiver = tolower(hesitation_receiver),
    any_hesitation = if_else(
      hesitation_server == "yes" | hesitation_receiver == "yes",
      "Hesitation in rally",
      "No hesitation"
    )
  )

library(ggplot2)

ggplot(data, aes(x = any_hesitation, y = shots_total, fill = any_hesitation)) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, outlier.shape = NA, color = "black", alpha = 0.8) +
  stat_summary(
    fun = "mean",
    geom = "point",
    shape = 21,
    size = 2.5,
    fill = "white",
    color = "black"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("No hesitation" = , "Hesitation in rally" = "lightskyblue")) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of rally length with and without hesitation",
    x = "Presence of hesitation in rally",
    y = "Total shots in rally"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none"
  )
```

 hesitation is more frequent when rally is long

# insights

```{r}
# make sure serving_team_win is numeric 0/1, not factor
data <- data |>
  mutate(
    serving_team_win_num = as.numeric(serving_team_win),  # if serving_team_win is 0/1, this is fine
    hes_server_bin   = if_else(tolower(hesitation_server) == "yes", 1, 0),
    hes_receiver_bin = if_else(tolower(hesitation_receiver) == "yes", 1, 0)
  )

# logistic regression: probability serving team wins ~ server/receiver hesitation
hes_model <- glm(
  serving_team_win_num ~ hes_server_bin + hes_receiver_bin,
  data   = data,
  family = binomial(link = "logit")
)

summary(hes_model)
```

```{r}
# get coefficient estimates
coef_hes <- coef(hes_model)

b0 <- coef_hes["(Intercept)"]
b1 <- coef_hes["hes_server_bin"]
b2 <- coef_hes["hes_receiver_bin"]

# helper: inverse logit
inv_logit <- function(x) exp(x) / (1 + exp(x))

# predicted win probabilities for each scenario
p_none      <- inv_logit(b0)               # no one hesitates
p_server    <- inv_logit(b0 + b1)          # server hesitates only
p_receiver  <- inv_logit(b0 + b2)          # receiver hesitates only
p_both      <- inv_logit(b0 + b1 + b2)     # both hesitate

p_none; p_server; p_receiver; p_both
```
```{r}
alpha_penalty <- p_none - p_server
beta_bonus    <- p_receiver - p_none

alpha_penalty
beta_bonus
```


```{r}
# Create binary hesitation indicators
data <- data |>
  mutate(
    hes_server_bin   = if_else(tolower(hesitation_server) == "yes", 1, 0),
    hes_receiver_bin = if_else(tolower(hesitation_receiver) == "yes", 1, 0)
  )

# Compute Hesitation Impact Score (HIS) per rally
data <- data |>
  mutate(
    # ensure serving_team_win is numeric 0/1
    serving_team_win_num = as.numeric(serving_team_win),

    # HIS = outcome - alpha*server_hes + beta*receiver_hes
    HIS = serving_team_win_num -
      alpha_penalty * hes_server_bin +
      beta_bonus    * hes_receiver_bin
  )
head(data)

```



```{r}
his_scenarios <- data |>
  mutate(
    scenario = case_when(
      hes_server_bin == 0 & hes_receiver_bin == 0 ~ "No hesitation (either side)",
      hes_server_bin == 1 & hes_receiver_bin == 0 ~ "Server hesitated only",
      hes_server_bin == 0 & hes_receiver_bin == 1 ~ "Receiver hesitated only",
      hes_server_bin == 1 & hes_receiver_bin == 1 ~ "Both hesitated"
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(scenario) |>
  summarise(
    n_rallies = n(),
    mean_HIS  = mean(HIS, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_HIS    = sd(HIS, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(mean_HIS))

his_scenarios
```
